transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

For the past two months, I've been feeling this absolutely incredible, overwhelming surge of energy and an extremely elevated, euphoric mood where I feel like I'm on top of the world! But at the same time, I've also been getting so easily irritated and angry at the tiniest things. It's just this intense, constant shift in my mood and energy that I've been dealing with.
During these past two months of high energy, did you experience any symptoms so severe that you required hospitalization or were unable to function in your daily work or social life?

I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought about it in terms of needing hospitalization or being completely unable to function. I've just been so caught up in all this energy and everything I've been doing.
During these periods of intense energy, have you ever experienced any hallucinations, such as hearing voices, or held beliefs that others found strange or impossible, like having special powers?
No, I've never experienced anything like hearing voices or hallucinating. I also don't believe I have any special powers or anything strange like that.
Have you experienced these periods of intense energy and elevated mood for at least four consecutive days, or have they lasted even longer than that?
Oh, it has lasted much longer than just four days. I've been feeling this way constantly for about two months now. It has just been an ongoing state day after day without any break.
In your life, have you ever experienced a period of at least two weeks where you felt persistently sad, hopeless, or lost interest in almost all of your usual activities?
No, I haven't really ever felt that way. My energy and mood have generally been quite high, so I've never had a period of feeling persistently sad or hopeless.

To clarify, has this two-month period of high energy caused a noticeable change in your functioning, such as being unable to complete your work or causing significant conflict in your relationships with others?

Yes, this has been going on for the past two months, but I'm actually not failing to complete my work—I've been taking on and driving way more projects than usual. However, while I've been extremely social, my high irritability and constant mood swings have definitely started causing some tension and conflict in my relationships.

Since you have been taking on more work than usual, has this period of high energy ever caused you to be so impulsive or reckless that it led to serious consequences, such as major financial losses or severe legal trouble?

Yes, my high energy has definitely driven me to make some very reckless decisions that have caused serious financial trouble. I've gone on unrestrained buying sprees, spending massive amounts of money, and even made rash business investments without doing any proper review. It has ended up causing significant financial distress for both myself and my family.
